name: The Chinese Room Argument
description: Learn John Searl's Chinese Room Argument to find out whether AI will ever become sentient. An AI-powered app built for 'Day of AI Australia'.

name: AI Dinner Table Conversation
description: An AI-powered dinner table conversation with whoever you want, alive or dead, real or fictional. You can set the context, discussion, and even reply yourself!

name: Cockatoo Clicker
description: Inspired by the classic 'Cookie Clicker', this reimagines world domination by the cookie eaters, cockatoo's. Leverage the power of Kookabura's and luxury cages to exponentially grow the cockatoo population.

name: Ghost Notes
description: Send and receive a mystery note from a random stranger!

name: Steam Hidden Gem Finder
description: Have an overflowing Steam library but still don't know what to play? Use this hidden gem finder to find the top rated games you still haven't given a chance!

name: Sushi Cat - Discord Bot
description: A Discord bot which helps you track your to-do-list items, manage your study time with a Pomodoro-style timer, and get a series of random dad jokes to distract you from said study.

name: Gudetama's Escape
description: A video game built for my girlfriend to celebrate our first christmas after almost one year of dating. Play as a recently won claw machine plushie who seeks to escape his new home, my uni dorm room.

name: LongLingo
description: LongLingo is a focused, spaced-repetition Chinese flashcard application designed to help users efficiently learn Mandarin Chinese vocabulary. Utilizing the science-backed FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) algorithm, it provides HSK-aligned progress tracking, Simplified/Traditional character toggles, Pinyin helpers, and integrated audio pronunciation without the need for manual deck creation.

name: Trackle
description: Guess the shortest path between two Sydney train stations. A daily puzzle game for rail enthusiasts.

name: The Trolley Problem
description: Will you pull the lever? Built for the Reddit x Phaser Game Jam, this game brings classic moral dilemmas to life, challenging players to make agonizing choices and engage in deep community debate. Cast your vote, defend your ethics, and see how your decisions stack up against the rest of the world!
